description: Website health, search-visibility and conversion check for any public URL. Returns a 0-100 score and a ranked list of issues, each with what was found, why it matters and the fix. About 20 checks: HTTPS and certificate, speed, mobile tag, title, description, headings, structured data, robots, sitemap, llms.txt, contact and call to action, broken links. Costs $0.02 per call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the site to check

name: site_check
